sentences.text: A candle may burn for a long time.
A road leads toward the village.
A long road makes you tired.
The road is covered with snow.
A mountain is tall and beautiful.
A green leaf is on the tree.
A lemon is yellow and sour.
A black dog guards the house.
The coffee is black and hot.
Night is quiet in the village.
The day begins in the morning.
The room is warm in winter.
A warm wind comes from the south.
In winter the air is cold.
The basket is full of apples.
The cup is full of water.
The room is full of guests.
I have not read the new book yet.
The old bridge is still strong.
An old friend is close to my heart.
Rotten fruit has a bad smell.
Draw a straight line on the board.
A dull needle does not pierce.
A smooth stone slides in water.
The dog's fur is wet from rain.
The right answer is written down.
The school is near the house.
The shop is near the stop.
The station is far from the village.
I write with the right hand.
The door is on the right side.
I open the door with the left hand.
The window is on the left side.
Start the step with the left foot.
The lamp is lit on the table.
The cat is sitting on the roof.
I forgot the key on the shelf.
The letter is in the envelope.
The dog sleeps in the box.
Mother is with me in the kitchen.

sentences.target: թեյը մեղրի հետ ավելի համով է։

sentences.text: Father and mother are at home.
I have a red and a blue pen.
If it rains I will stay home.
If you have time call me.
If you are hungry I will give soup.
I stayed home because I am sick.

sentences.target: աշխատում եմ որովհետև փող է պետք։
sentences.text: I work because money is needed.
I am happy because you came.
Write the name on the notebook.
We chose a new name for the dog.
